### Notes

Could not inspect: the deal catalogue itself, individual vendor offers, amounts, durations and per-deal terms all sit behind account.ycombinator.com authentication. Only the public landing page was readable. Access is described for YC companies (via external partners offering 'discounts and special services to YC companies') and for YC event attendees. Imported from a verification sweep whose quote fidelity later failed audit in 13 of 22 sampled records. This entry was NOT independently re-audited, so the evidence quote may be a close paraphrase rather than the vendor's exact wording. Re-read the source before relying on precise phrasing. Re-confirmed 2026-09-16: the page publishes NO total dollar value and NO deal count - the widely cited '$500,000' and '100+ deals' figures do not appear on it. Access is limited to YC companies and YC event attendees.
